LESSON: READING 10.4.1 INTENSIVE READING: SHORT STORY (CLASS READER)

Grade: Grade 8
Subject: ENGLISH
Strand: Strand 10
Topic 10.4: Reading 10.4.1 Intensive Reading: Short story (Class Reader)
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 2

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Reading 10.4.1 Intensive Reading: Short story (Class Reader), part of Strand 10 in Grade 8 ENGLISH.

Key inquiry question: how the events in the short story relate to real life. 1. How do events flow logically in a story?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Reading 10.4.1 Intensive Reading: Short story (Class Reader) together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
• Communication and collaboration: It is enhanced as the learner discusses with peers the main events and how they relate to

real life.

• Creativity and imagination: It is enhanced as the learner uses a graphic organizer to highlight the events in the story.

Values:
Unity: It is promoted as the learner displays team spirit while working with peers to discuss how the events in the short story

relate to real life.

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
(PCIs):

Creative thinking skills: They are developed as the learner relates events in the short story to real life.

Link to other Learning Areas:
